name: Please Be Quiet Kentucky 2023
information: Due to limited space, we are limiting each competitor to 1 guest. If your registration has more than 1 guest, your registration will not be accepted. This is a PBQ competition. There will not be 3x3 at this competition. For a more normal competition experience, please check out other competitions in the area. We HIGHLY discourage competitors from only signing up for clock. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXBEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3440ef949907336b2807b1eb73f2734f6349e226/image.png)
